Birthday Treasure Hunt

An immersive, clue-filled adventure delivered to you. Perfect for curious minds and energetic celebrations. We handle everything from setup to guiding the explorers through their journey.

Our flexible programs guarantee that each event is customised for every age. Activities range from lively relay races and melodic coordination games to intricate problem-solving tasks and searching for hidden treasures to unlock a final mystery phrase for the group.

To maximise the experience and reduce additional hassle for you, we bring small treasure bags for each adventurer at the party!

2.5–3H TOTAL TIME, FOR PRICING CONTACT US
